experiences.description: Working as a Research Analyst at WebAm Media, where I conduct in-depth research on police-related cases across the United States. My responsibilities include identifying relevant incidents, collecting accurate case details, and professionally communicating with U.S. police departments via email to request body-worn camera footage under public records and FOIA guidelines. This role has strengthened my research accuracy, documentation practices, and professional communication skills while working remotely.

Worked as a Data Analyst Intern at IAG Soft, where I assisted in analyzing structured datasets to extract meaningful insights for business decision-making. I performed data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, and basic visualization to identify trends and patterns. This internship enhanced my understanding of real-world data workflows, improved my analytical thinking, and strengthened my ability to work with data-driven solutions in a professional environment.
